dhcp-server:
how system dhcp server
config system dhcp server
    edit 1
        set default-gateway 10.255.1.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set interface "fortilink"
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set end-ip 10.255.1.254
                set start-ip 10.255.1.2
            next
        end
    next
    edit 2
        set dns-service local
        set default-gateway 10.10.10.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set interface "vlan10"
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set end-ip 10.10.10.200
                set start-ip 10.10.10.100
            next
        end
    next
    edit 3
        set default-gateway 10.10.30.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set interface "vlan30"
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set end-ip 10.10.30.200
                set start-ip 10.10.30.100
            next
        end
    next
end
FGT-MTZ #
ntp:
how system ntp
config system ntp
    set type custom
    config ntpserver
        edit 1
            set server "a.ntp.br"
        next
    end
end
FGT-MTZ #
vlan10:
how system interface vlan10
config system interface
    edit "vlan10"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set role lan
        set interface "port5"
        set vlanid 10
    next
end
FGT-MTZ #
zone:
how system zone
config system zone
    edit "INTERNAS"
        set interface "vlan10" "vlan20"
        set uuid 9b1fe590-9e1f-ea49-9d1f-e8b6a01f
    next
end
FGT-MTZ #
